findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code execution via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("execfile").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("input").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution operation"
findings.hypothesis: Check for use of eval/exec/compile functions which could lead to code injection

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description Potentially exponential regular expressions that could lead to denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "fullmatch", "findall", "finditer"]).getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("re.compile").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("re.search").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("re.match").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("re.fullmatch").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("re.findall").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("re.finditer").getACall()
select call, "Regular expression operation that could be vulnerable to ReDoS if pattern is user-controlled"
findings.hypothesis: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) vulnerabilities in HTTP parsing
